option_relations.rationale: Meningitis is a general term for inflammation of the meninges. Candida tropicalis meningitis is a specific type of meningitis caused by Candida tropicalis. Therefore, meningitis is a supertype of Candida tropicalis meningitis.
Meningoencephalitis involves inflammation of both the meninges and the brain. Meningitis is a component of meningoencephalitis, making it a supertype in this context.
Skull base osteomyelitis (fungal) is an infection of the skull base bones, which is distinct from meningitis, an inflammation of the meninges.
Fungal meningoencephalitis (Candida tropicalis) is a specific type of meningoencephalitis. Meningitis is a component of meningoencephalitis, making it a supertype in this context.
